name: EPM_Repeated Denied or Blocked Privilege Attempts
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: EPM_Repeated Denied or Blocked Privilege Attempts
// Vendor: BeyondTrust
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with EPM_Repeated Denied or Blocked Privilege Attempts.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0004 - Privilege Escalation
// Technique: T1548 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = beyondtrust_epm_raw

| filter is_epm_event = true
| filter is_epm_privilege_event = true
| filter epm_event_code = 116

| alter
    epm_process_command_line = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.command_line"),
    epm_parent_process_name = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.name")

// Group repeated blocks in the correlation rule search window
| comp
    count() as blocked_count,
    min(_time) as first_seen,
    max(_time) as last_seen,
    values(process_name) as blocked_applications,
    values(process_path) as blocked_paths,
    values(epm_process_command_line) as blocked_commands,
    values(epm_parent_process_name) as parent_processes
  by epm_username, endpoint_name

| filter blocked_count >= 5

| filter (`blocked_paths` not contains """c:\\windows\\system32\\backgroundtaskhost.exe""") 

| fields
    first_seen,
    last_seen,
    blocked_count,
    epm_username,
    endpoint_name,
    blocked_applications,
    blocked_paths,
    blocked_commands,
    parent_processes
description: Detectar repetição de processos bloqueados pelo EPM para o mesmo usuário e endpoint em curto intervalo. Usa Event ID 116, agrega por epm_username + endpoint_name, coleta aplicações e caminhos e alerta quando blocked_count >= 3 na janela de execução de 30 minutos.
alert_name: EPM_Repeated Denied or Blocked Privilege Attempts
alert_description: Foram identificados $blocked_count processos bloqueados pelo BeyondTrust EPM para o usuário $epm_username no endpoint $endpoint_name , entre $first_seen e $last_seen . O SOC deve validar as aplicações, caminhos e comandos envolvidos para identificar tentativa de contorno de política ou repetição legítima.
